# SourceBadge

> Linked source badge with an automatic same-origin favicon, derived hostname, and resilient fallback.

This file matches the installed `source-badge` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/source-badge.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/source-badge.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `lucide-react@^1.78.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `avatar`
- `badge`
- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/badge-knobs`: `badgeKnobs`, types `BadgeKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/source-badge-knobs`: `sourceBadgeKnobs`, types `SourceBadgeKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/source-badge`: `sourceHostname`, `sourceFaviconHref`, `SourceFavicon`, `SourceBadge`, types `SourceBadgeProps`, `SourceFaviconProps`

## Composition

### Linked source

The badge supplies its favicon automatically; SourceFavicon can also be used independently.

```tsx
<SourceBadge>
  <SourceFavicon />
</SourceBadge>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { SourceBadge } from "@/components/control-ui/source-badge";

export function SourceBadgeExample() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <SourceBadge href="https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/marker" faviconSrc="https://ui.shadcn.com/favicon.ico">
        shadcn/ui
      </SourceBadge>
      <SourceBadge href="https://base-ui.com/react/components/collapsible" faviconSrc="https://base-ui.com/favicon.ico" />
      <SourceBadge href="https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility" faviconSrc="/missing-favicon.ico">
        MDN
      </SourceBadge>
    </div>
  );
}
```
